name: mimu-geonode-myanmar-monsoon-rice-sown-area-v1
notes:
Rice sown area estimation from Sentinel-1 SAR and Sentinel-2 optical images using Random Forest Machine Learning method.

The map should be used in association with the sample based area estimation. Area estimation data (95% CI) can be access 
@https://data.humdata.org/dataset/myanmar-state-region-level-monsoon-season-rice-sown-estimation-for-2021-2023.

Original dataset title: Myanmar Monsoon Rice Sown Area 2023_v1
